layout.arrangement: A red-outlined light-gray content panel inset within a white page and extending flush to the bottom edge of the slide. The title is centered horizontally in the upper-middle of the panel; two blue text lines sit left-aligned below it; a small yellow oval slide-number badge sits in the panel's top-right corner. A white mouse-cursor arrow (screen-recording artifact, not part of the intended design) floats just above the title.

regions.name: Outer page margin
regions.position: full-slide perimeter frame; thin white strip visible on left, right, and top only (~4% left/right, ~8% top); no bottom strip because the content panel is flush with the slide bottom
regions.content: plain white background framing the content panel

regions.name: Content panel
regions.position: left 4% to right 96%, top 8% to bottom 100% (flush with bottom edge)
regions.content: light-gray rectangle with a dark-red border containing all slide text

regions.name: Title
regions.content: large bold red text 'Multi-Head  Attention' (note: double space between the two words)

regions.name: Slide number badge
regions.content: yellow oval with purple outline containing the number 40

regions.content: white arrow pointer with black outline pointing up-left; screen-recording artifact — exclude from recreation

layout.hierarchy: The red title dominates by size and color; the two blue lines are secondary (roughly 60-65% of title size, equal weight to each other); the slide-number badge is the smallest element; the red panel border frames everything.

visual_elements.description: Full-content rectangle with a thin dark-red solid border (~2px) and light-gray fill; acts as the slide's frame. Its bottom edge is cut off at the slide bottom.
visual_elements.position: inset panel covering ~92% of slide width and ~92% of height, flush to bottom

visual_elements.description: Slide-number badge: small horizontal oval/ellipse with yellow fill, purple outline, containing the text '40' in small dark text, centered.
visual_elements.position: top-right corner inside the panel, ~93% horizontal, ~13% vertical (bounding box ~90%-95% width, ~9%-18% height)

visual_elements.description: A small white mouse-cursor arrow icon (screen-recording artifact) floating above the title, pointing up-left.
visual_elements.position: top-center, ~54% horizontal, ~33% vertical, just above the title

imagery: Mouse cursor arrow (white with black outline), a screen-capture artifact, located just above and slightly right of the title's center; not part of the intended slide design.
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title is bold, very large (~40-44pt equivalent), red, with an apparent double space between 'Multi-Head' and 'Attention'. The two body lines are bold, medium-large (~26-28pt equivalent), blue, left-aligned, with no bullet glyphs/markers — they read as unadorned list items. Slide number is small, regular weight. No italics, no all-caps. Concrete sizes used in the recreation brief: title 42pt, body 27pt, badge number 10pt (chosen within the estimated ranges; 27/42 ≈ 64% matches the stated 60-65% hierarchy ratio).
animation_state: Slide appears fully built: both text lines are visible with no dimming or partial reveal. The presence of a live mouse cursor suggests this frame was captured from a recorded lecture, but nothing is mid-build.
recreation_brief: 1. Background: set the slide background to solid white #FFFFFF (no gradient, no texture). 2. Content panel: draw one rectangle from x=4% to x=96% of slide width and y=8% to y=100% of slide height (bottom edge flush with the slide bottom); fill #E6E6E6; solid dark-red border #C00000 at ~2pt; square corners, no shadow. 3. Title: add one text box spanning ~28%-74% of slide width with vertical center at ~41% of slide height; text exactly 'Multi-Head  Attention' (preserve the double space between the words); Arial bold 42pt; color #CC0000; centered alignment. 4. Bullet line 1: add one text box with left edge at ~17% of slide width and vertical center at ~65% of slide height; text exactly 'Wide Architecture'; Arial bold 27pt; color #0000CC; left-aligned; no bullet glyph or marker. 5. Bullet line 2: add one text box with left edge at ~17% of slide width and vertical center at ~80% of slide height; text exactly 'Narrow Architecture'; Arial bold 27pt; color #0000CC; left-aligned; no bullet glyph or marker. 6. Slide-number badge shape: draw one oval with bounding box from ~90% to ~95% of slide width and ~9% to ~18% of slide height (center ≈ 92.5% horizontal, 13.5% vertical); fill #FFFF99; outline #7030A0 at ~1pt. 7. Badge number: add one small text box centered inside the oval with text exactly '40'; Arial regular 10pt; color #333333; centered alignment. 8. Exclusion: do NOT draw the mouse cursor (white arrow with black outline at ~54% horizontal, ~33% vertical, pointing up-left) — it is a screen-recording artifact, not slide content. 9. Completeness check: the slide has no subtitle, no charts, no tables, no equations, and no images; add nothing beyond steps 1-7.

fixes_applied: Corrected 'Outer page margin' region: it claimed a white strip 'visible on all sides', but the content panel runs to bottom 100% (flush), so the white margin exists only on the left, right, and top.

Added a 7th layout region 'Mouse cursor artifact' so layout.regions covers every element listed in visual_elements and imagery; the region is flagged as a screen-recording artifact to exclude from recreation.
Added the mouse-cursor artifact to layout.arrangement so the arrangement string accounts for all visible elements.

Reconciled badge geometry: the original recreation_brief said '~3.5% wide' while layout.regions specifies ~90%-95% width and ~9%-18% height; the brief now uses the region extents (bounding box 90%-95% width, 9%-18% height, center ~92.5%/13.5%).

Added '#333333 (badge number text)' to colors.accents — the color appeared in visual_elements but was missing from the colors map; also standardized the brief's badge text color from 'dark gray/black' to #333333.

Adjusted brief font sizes from 40pt/28pt to 42pt (title) and 27pt (body): 28/40 = 70% contradicted the stated hierarchy that body lines are 60-65% of title size; 27/42 ≈ 64% satisfies both the hierarchy note and the estimated ranges (title 40-44pt, body 26-28pt).
Kept subtitle_or_header = null after verifying against all regions, visual elements, and verbatim text that no subtitle or header exists on the slide (genuinely absent from the source).
Rewrote recreation_brief as a 9-step ordered checklist with one element per step, each specifying exact text, percentage coordinates, hex colors, font sizes, and shape types.
Verified no vague quantifiers ('several', 'some', 'many', 'a few', 'various') remain; all counts are exact: 1 title, 2 bullet lines, 1 content panel, 1 badge, 1 cursor artifact.
uncertain_items: Exact red hue of the title (#CC0000) versus the panel border (#C00000) cannot be verified without the image; both are dark red and may be the same color in the original design.
The double space inside 'Multi-Head  Attention' is preserved verbatim but may be a vision-extraction artifact rather than intentional formatting.
All font sizes are model estimates (title ~40-44pt, body ~26-28pt, badge number 'small'); the brief uses 42pt / 27pt / 10pt as concrete in-range values.

The badge is described as a 'horizontal oval', but its region extents (~5% of width × ~9% of height, roughly equal in absolute size on a standard 16:9 slide) imply a near-circular shape; the exact aspect ratio is unverifiable.
The mouse cursor's exact position (~54% horizontal, ~33% vertical) is approximate; it is a recording artifact and is deliberately excluded from the recreation steps.
